extraction_notes: All measurements and oracle outcomes are copied from the cited artifacts; medians/min/max are derived only from present finite numeric samples.
Each RCD1 comparison case has three measured repeats; Engine has one measured run per cell. Independent warmups are excluded.
RCD1 completion rates use the recorded source/receiver completion denominator including ACK/finish/drain; Engine timing uses its separately recorded in-process scope and is not directly comparable.
Actual transaction counts and row/byte extrema are native observations, not configured batch maxima.
assume_unique is a synthetic zero-duplicate diagnostic only; it skips an obligation and is not an equivalent production optimization or an exact full-chain qualification.

Full canonical-blob-set / all-ten-Tick-field oracle methods and outcomes are preserved. Large per-symbol count maps are reduced to coverage totals with complete originals retained at source summary/result paths.
No Redis INFO payloads, raw input records, original market data, hardware narratives, or production certification are copied.
Native service counters do not strengthen observed SQLite PRAGMAs; Null consumption is not durable Storage completion.
Recorded PASS/verified labels are historical artifact results, not a claim that this extraction reran tests or the current stricter validator.
